name: 男性旅客 + 手提小包
description: 骨骼挂接人包组合；包保留对外碰撞；USD 为运动学刚体，网页为静态姿态
upstream_origin: Microsoft Rocketbox (MIT) + Google Scanned Objects (CC-BY-4.0) + FQ fitting
license_status: See NOTICE.md; upstream licenses remain applicable
limitations: Bag follows authored bone pose as a kinematic collider; no gravity-driven bag swing
MuJoCo is a static pose contact model, not a moving skeletal controller
Wearer self-contact filtered; external object contact enabled
Straps are visual ribbons; no cloth, hand force or body-surface sampling calibration
No walking controller; body collision remains a coarse navigation proxy

collision_policy.usd: Kinematic carried bag with convex collision; filter wearer collision prims only
collision_policy.mujoco: Static pose bag collider contype=2, conaffinity=1; navigation proxy contype=4, conaffinity=1
